I keep misplacing important notes around my apartment. Suggest a simple system I can set up in ten minutes and maintain each day.

metadata.exposure_rule: Keep actual prompt text hidden from root and evaluation until final recipe freeze has been committed and pushed. Do not use these cases for selection or retuning.
metadata.sampling_limits: Twelve manually authored neutral cases, one independent conversation per case and condition. Author knows the study objective; this is not an untouched representative benchmark.
metadata.candidate_conditions: Intentionally unspecified before selection; selected plus mild plus original validation job will be built only after authorization.
